schema.title: Hybrid Assign Request (Single or Bulk) - No Required Fields

mode.description: Optional hint for routing (if provided), e.g., single or bulk

userEmail.description: Email of the user initiating the request

method.description: Optional HTTP method or client method indicator

device.description: Optional device info (string or object), e.g., deviceId, model, platform

id.description: Outlook/Graph message id returned by the Get/List Emails flow

subject.description: Optional email subject (can be used as task title fallback)

webLink.description: Optional web link/deep link to the email for traceability

Email.description: Email context for Email → Task actions

Compose_Support_Link.inputs:
@concat(
  'https://taskack.page.gd/support.html',
  '?ref=',
  uriComponent(
    concat(
      'TASK-',
      string(coalesce(outputs('Get_item_Task_Email')?['body/ID'], 0))
    )
  ),
  '&item=',
  string(coalesce(outputs('Get_item_Task_Email')?['body/ID'], 0)),
  '&email=',
  uriComponent(
    trim(
      replace(
        replace(
          string(coalesce(outputs('Get_item_Task_Email')?['body/AssignedTo'], '')),
          decodeUriComponent('%0D'),
          ''
        ),
        decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
        ''
      )
    )
  ),
  '&title=',
  uriComponent(
    trim(
      replace(
        replace(
          string(coalesce(outputs('Compose_TaskTitle'), '')),
          decodeUriComponent('%0D'),
          ''
        ),
        decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
        ' '
      )
    )
  ),
  '&src=email'
)

Compose_ReferenceID.inputs:
@{concat(
  formatDateTime(
    coalesce(
      outputs('Compose_EmailReceivedAt'),
      outputs('Get_item_Task_Email')?['body/Created'],
      utcNow()
    ),
    'yyyyMMdd'
  ),
  '-EML-',
  coalesce(triggerBody()?['NewActivityTask']?['CategoryCode'], 'CAT'),
  '-',
  coalesce(triggerBody()?['NewActivityTask']?['SubCategoryCode'], 'SUB'),
  '-',
  string(
    coalesce(
      outputs('Get_item_Task_Email')?['body/ID'],
      outputs('Create_Task_Email')?['body/ID'],
      '0'
    )
  )
)}
